app.name: OmniConvert
app.tagline: Local-first all-in-one file converter. Every conversion happens inside your browser — your files never leave your device.

home.heading: OmniConvert
home.bootstrapNotice: Phase 4 complete: the FFmpeg audio/video engine is wired up — you can now convert MP4 / WebM / MP3 / WAV / FLAC and more. Next phase brings the Pandoc document engine.

privacy.title: Zero uploads
privacy.description: All conversions run inside your browser via WebAssembly — files never leave your device.

engines.title: Three engines
engines.description: ImageMagick, FFmpeg and Pandoc together cover every common image, audio/video and document format.

platforms.title: Every platform
platforms.description: Identical experience on the web and on Windows / macOS / Ubuntu desktop apps.

upload.heading: Upload files
upload.description: Drag files here or click to pick. Everything is processed locally — nothing is uploaded.
upload.browseHint: Supports common image, audio/video and document formats

convert.noEligible: Pick a target format for at least one file first

error.generic: Conversion failed — please retry or check the file

fileCard.magicMismatch: Extension does not match file contents

largeFile.title: Use the desktop app for large files
largeFile.description: This file is larger than {threshold}. Converting in the browser may fail due to memory limits. The desktop app uses native CLI tools and handles GB-scale files reliably.

footer.tagline: Privacy first · Runs locally · Open source
